Counter-torque for camshafts

The tools fitted are used to produce a reaction whilst removing the idler gears.

1. Loosen the bolt fixing the collar joining the rigid section of the intake pipe to the turbocharger.

2. Undo the bolt fixing the engine oil vapour pipe connector.

3. Remove the rigid section of the air pipe from the turbocharger.

1. Undo the fixing bolts.

2. Remove the rear gears protective cover and oil seal.

1. Undo the bolt fixing the exhaust camshaft.

2. Undo the bolt fixing the inlet camshaft.

3. Undo the bolts (3a) fixing the idler gears to the camshaft housing, applying pressure at the point shown by the arrow (3b) and remove the idler gears (3c).

In order to be able to remove the assembly, the piston inside the idler gears has to be compressed. The outer profile of the idler gears is not symmetrical which prevents any incorrect fitting.
